scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/editor.js && esbuild src/styles/preview.css --bundle --outfile=dist/preview.css
scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings src/main.ts src/editor src/types test package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format --error-on-warnings src test package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts biome.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src test package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts biome.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run coverage && npm run build
